title: Great can opener, but no magnet
text: Great can opener, but no magnet. I liked the idea of this can opener, I thought the magnet to hold lids gave it something different and interesting. But it turns out, the magnet doesn't seem to work at all! I tried using it and while the can opener part works well enough, I can't get anything to stick to the "magnet". In fact, I'm beginning to wonder if it really is a magnet at all! I tried sticking all sorts of metal things to it that SHOULD respond to magnets, and got nothing in response. It seems like a dud. Mine either isn't magnetized or the magnet part is missing? I have the rubber and metal piece that they claim is the magnet, so I can't tell what went wrong, but I'm disappointed. Giving it 3 stars because it still works as a can opener which we needed anyway. And it looks nice with the gold handles, but it's really just a fancy looking standard can opener.
